name: XX_space pd policeHQ boss mech volley bullet
comment: A missile from the Bot Battle Merc's launcher: lands where the player is (6–25 m away; ×0.33 on a hit) with the red X marker (413361) where it will land. The Police HQ boss mech fires many by Lua 885 (more as its health drops); a regular Bot Battle Merc fires one per cast (the user: it shoots missiles). RechargeDelay 3 s, ItemDelay 0.5 s and AIPowerrating 5 are guesses: the client gives none.
